name.full: CareAssurance Copilot - Healthcare Compliance AI Agent

description.short: AI agent for UK healthcare compliance, EMAR audits and care plans.
description.full: CareAssurance Copilot is an AI agent that executes healthcare compliance tasks for UK domiciliary and residential care organisations. It performs EMAR audits, visit audits, care plan generation, risk assessments, PRN protocol generation, drug interaction checks, email rewriting, and platform data access - all following CQC 2024 standards and UK care regulations.
